text: SELECT player_id, player_name, SUM(pts) * 1.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN played = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS points_per_game, SUM(reb) * 1.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN played = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rebounds_per_game, SUM(ast) * 1.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN played = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS assists_per_game, SUM(CASE WHEN played = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS games_played FROM "nba_golden"."dev"."player_game_stats" WHERE game_date >= '2017-01-01' AND game_date < '2018-01-01' GROUP BY player_id, player_name HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN played = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 20 ORDER BY points_per_game DESC, player_name ASC LIMIT 10
